The most common win left on "Electric 10s" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $1,000, and sixteen of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything above about "Electric 10s" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

2773.headline: Another top prize was claimed

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" is still new, with most of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Everything above about "The Price is Right™" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
